title: AI CBSE Class 10 Tutor
idea: An AI-powered tutor for CBSE Class 10 students in India that personalizes math and science practice based on past board exams.

title: Automated Cloud FinOps for Startups
idea: A lightweight autonomous agent that continuously analyzes AWS/GCP bills, identifies idle resources, and applies automated cost-reduction PRs.

title: Micro-SaaS Shopify SEO Optimizer
idea: AI tool that scans Shopify product catalogs and automatically rewrites descriptions, meta tags, and alt text to boost organic search ranking.

title: B2B Compliance Evidence Collector
idea: Continuous compliance platform that connects to GitHub, AWS, and Slack to auto-generate audit-ready evidence for SOC2 and ISO27001.

title: AI Voice Receptionist for Dental Clinics
idea: Voice AI assistant that answers after-hours phone calls for dental clinics, triages emergencies, and books appointments directly into EHR.

title: Async Video Standup & Summary for Remote Teams
idea: Tool where remote engineering teams record 60-second video updates that get transcribed, summarized, and posted into Jira and Slack.

title: API-First Carbon Accounting for Logistics
idea: Developer API enabling freight forwarders and logistics companies to calculate and report per-shipment Scope 3 carbon emissions.

title: Local Contractor Invoice Factoring Marketplace
idea: Fintech platform offering instant cash flow advances on unpaid invoices for independent home service contractors and electricians.

title: AI Legal Contract Risk Analyzer for Freelancers
idea: Browser extension and web app that highlights predatory clauses, payment delays, and IP transfer terms in client freelance contracts.

title: Personalized Recipe & Grocery Cart Generator
idea: Weekly meal planning app that creates customized family recipes based on dietary restrictions and auto-populates local grocery delivery carts.
